headers_that_matter.Set-Cookie: nightlio_token=<JWT>; Expires=<TS>; Max-Age=3600; HttpOnly; Path=/; SameSite=Lax

notes: Credentialed branch is taken whenever username OR password is present in the JSON body.

user.id is autoincrement. Observed 5 (not 2) on a fresh DB because each credential-free login upserts the self-host user with INSERT ... ON CONFLICT, and every conflicting insert attempt burns an autoincrement value. Do not grade exact ids.
Body shape is identical to the credential-free branch: {token, user:{id,name,email,avatar_url}}.
